data.narrative:
Nitricity is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $102.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company (ticker 277810.KQ) operating in the same sector. Primary peers include Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Divergent, and Exotec, all at comparable stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses total capital raised ($103M) as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $195M. Peer-median analysis examines three directly comparable Series B robotics companies: Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B). The median valuation across this set is $1.8B, with a range of $1.6B to $2.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $166M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median point of $973M. The substantial spread reflects a key tension: stage-progression mechanics suggest a more conservative $195M valuation, while peer comparables indicate substantially higher values in the $1.6B–$2.0B band. The wide dispersion underscores uncertainty around Nitricity's relative technology maturity, revenue traction, and competitive positioning versus named peers. Additional disclosure of revenue, unit economics, or technology differentiation would refine this range materially.
